sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Clean-shaven serious near-frontal man, grey-white swept-back short wavy hair with side curls, thick grey-dark brows, plain light grey pointed shirt partly open at neck, small visible grey center button, no tie or jacket. Full blue painted background. Keep source hair/brows, smooth clean chin, shirt and crop/lighting; compact round mascot head and short broad collar transition.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal serious man, swept-back short dark brown hair with grey streaks and side curls, dark brows, black rounded-rectangular glasses covering eyes, grey-black moustache only and clean chin. Black broad-lapel suit, pale lilac pointed shirt, charcoal necktie. Blue background. Preserve glasses position, moustache only, hair/brows, shirt/tie/jacket and crop/light; short broad fitted mascot neck, no invented chin beard.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal serious man, swept-back short silver-grey hair/side curls and dark grey brows, full salt-grey moustache plus short jaw-and-chin beard. Brown broad-lapel coat, pale grey-blue pointed shirt, dark navy tie with diagonal light blue stripes. Blue painted background. Preserve source full beard, moustache, hair/brows, outfit and crop/light, round mascot head with short broad fitted neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal woman slightly turned toward viewer left, brown side-part hair swept close above ears and rolled at nape, dark brows, small light pearl-like stud earrings, serious closed mouth. Off-white lab coat with broad lapels over grey V-neck knit whose narrow pale grey trim forms double V; pale inner fabric. Full blue background. Preserve hairstyle/brows/earrings and exact coat/knit neckline, pose/crop/light; short broad fitted mascot neck.
